title: 5 第5章 外门测试6 第6章 竹林卫
content_zh:
凌厉的长剑飘忽不定，如同天边的流云，让人摸不清下一剑会刺向哪里。
这张彬实力达到了凝脉三阶，用的更是黄阶中级剑法。
那威力，就算是同阶弟子都不敢轻易接招，张彬根本不认为林轩能挡得住这一击。
好在林轩刚突破到凝脉境二阶，实力大增，他不断的后退，险而又险的避过了这一剑。
“妈的，真邪门！
你竟然能避开！”
张彬一剑刺空，有些失神。
“原来突破到凝脉境二阶了，这火灵芝的药力还真是强劲，不过这么好的东西，竟然让你这个废物给浪费了！”
张彬越说越恼怒，手中的招式变得更加狠毒。
轰！
长剑被蓝色的灵力包裹，一下子将那木头墙轰开，顿时狂风呼呼的往里灌，整个小屋都摇晃起来。
“我可没心情和你拖沓，你给我去死吧，你的鲜血，我收下了！”
张彬身上的气势更加强大了，手中长剑泛起道道光芒。
“你这也叫剑法？”
林轩毫不客气的打击道，“在我看来，漏洞百出！”
林轩前进一步，手中长剑突然起了变化，剑尖吐着寒芒，在空中留下一串剑影。
“清风剑法，这不可能！”
张彬惊叫道，“这可是黄阶高级剑法，你一个剑奴，怎么学会的？”
林轩嘴角泛起一丝冷笑，手中的长剑配合着屋外的狂风，在房屋中形成了一道无形的剑气。
“你给我等着！”

张彬被吓住了，他快速的冲出小屋，消失在狂风暴雨中。
林轩收起黑铁剑，松了口气，他整日陪唐玉练剑，这清风剑法的招式他早就看会了。
不过，也只是徒具外形而已，他不知道剑诀心法，威力小的可怜，吓吓张彬这样的还行，真要打起来，这招没用一点伤害。
这张彬一定不会善罢甘休，我现在不易和他在起冲突，还是等加入玄剑宗后在和他算账吧。
小木屋被打的破烂，想睡觉是不可能了，林轩干脆盘膝而坐，再次修炼起长生诀。
还没入门，他就惹了不少弟子，没有强大的实力，他根本无法生存。
双手捏印，林轩进入修炼状态，他的体表泛起淡淡的青色光芒，如同黑夜中的一盏孤灯。
第二天清晨，雨停了，整个山峰格外的清新，到处都是泥土的芬芳。
林轩从打坐中醒来，活动了下筋骨，然后开始练剑。
还是那一招快如流星的剑法，虽然练习这一招有些枯燥，但是他还是一丝不苟的进行着。
昨晚，这招剑法已经展现出它的威力，虽然不知道这一招的品级，但是林轩知道它不比任何一种剑法差，甚至他还能从这剑法之中感受到一种特殊的剑意。
不过，唯一的缺点就是太消耗灵力，以林轩现在的实力，最多使用三次，就会被耗光灵力。
所以，这剑法适合一招制敌。
“咦，这么早？”
就在林轩练剑时，唐玉笑嘻嘻的从远处向这边走来，当他看到那小木屋时，那张精致的小脸顿时一寒。
“怎么回事？谁动的手？”
唐玉问道。
“没事，我自己能解决。”
林轩摇摇头。
content_en:
The sharp long sword is erratic, like the clouds in the sky, making it unclear where the sword will strike next.
Zhang Bin's strength has reached the third level of pulse condensation, and he uses yellow level intermediate swordsmanship.
With such power, even disciples of the same level did not dare to take the attack easily. Zhang Bin did not think that Lin Xuan could block this attack at all.
Fortunately, Lin Xuan had just broken through to the second level of the Pulse Condensation Realm and his strength had greatly increased. He kept retreating and narrowly avoided the sword.
“Damn, that’s so evil!
You were able to avoid it! "
Zhang Bin stabbed the air with his sword, feeling a little distracted.
"It turns out that I have broken through to the second level of the Pulse Condensation Realm. The medicinal power of this Fire Ganoderma is really strong, but such a good thing has been wasted by you, a waste!"
The more Zhang Bin talked, the angrier he became, and the moves in his hands became more vicious.
boom!
The long sword was wrapped in blue spiritual power and blasted open the wooden wall. Suddenly, strong wind roared in, and the whole cabin shook.
"I'm not in the mood to delay with you. Just go to hell. I'll take your blood!"
Zhang Bin's aura became even more powerful, and the sword in his hand glowed with light.
"You also call this swordsmanship?"
Lin Xuan struck unceremoniously, "In my opinion, it's full of loopholes!"
Lin Xuan took a step forward, and the long sword in his hand suddenly changed. The tip of the sword emitted a cold light, leaving a string of sword shadows in the air.
"Qingfeng Sword Technique, this is impossible!"
Zhang Bin exclaimed, "This is Huang-level advanced swordsmanship. How did you, a sword slave, learn it?"
A sneer appeared at the corner of Lin Xuan's mouth. The long sword in his hand combined with the strong wind outside the house to form an invisible sword energy in the house.
"Just wait for me!"
Zhang Bin was frightened. He quickly rushed out of the hut and disappeared into the violent storm.
Lin Xuan put away the black iron sword and breathed a sigh of relief. He had been practicing swordplay with Tang Yu all day long, and he had already learned the moves of Qingfeng Sword Technique.
However, it is just a mere appearance. He does not know the inner skills of the sword tactics, and its power is pitiful. It is okay to scare Zhang Bin, but if he really wants to fight, this move will not hurt him at all.
Zhang Bin will definitely not give up. It is not easy for me to have a conflict with him now. It is better to settle the score with him after joining the Xuanjian Sect.
The cabin was in tatters and it was impossible to sleep. Lin Xuan simply sat cross-legged and practiced the longevity technique again.
Before he even got started, he had offended many disciples. Without strong strength, he would not be able to survive at all.
Making seals with both hands, Lin Xuan entered the cultivation state, and his body surface glowed with a faint cyan light, like a lone lamp in the dark night.
Early the next morning, the rain stopped, and the entire mountain peak was exceptionally fresh, with the fragrance of earth everywhere.
Lin Xuan woke up from meditation, stretched his muscles, and then started practicing his sword.
It was still the same sword technique that was as fast as a meteor. Although practicing this move was a bit boring, he still performed it meticulously.
Last night, this sword technique had already demonstrated its power. Although he didn't know the grade of this move, Lin Xuan knew that it was no worse than any other sword technique. He could even feel a special sword intention from this sword technique.
However, the only drawback is that it consumes too much spiritual power. With Lin Xuan's current strength, he can use it three times at most and his spiritual power will be exhausted.
Therefore, this sword technique is suitable for defeating the enemy with one move.
"Hey, so early?"
While Lin Xuan was practicing his sword, Tang Yu walked towards this side from a distance with a smile. When he saw the small wooden house, his delicate little face suddenly became cold.
"What happened? Who did it?"
Tang Yu asked.
"It's okay, I can handle it myself."
Lin Xuan shook his head.
